reference: Read exact D,m,length from validated NSL-2 config; compare with historical KV reference

policy.rationale: Inherited KV null/physical/compatibility/energy/MAC and Newton gates. NSL-2R Q160/240 and physical component-peak residuals retained. Exact alpha identity uses an absolute floor 1e-12 plus relative 1e-6; elastic predictor error is descriptive, not a root acceptance gate.
policy.failure_policy: Persist diagnostics and stop the affected target. At most one auxiliary smaller-d root for an unsolved target, with recorded reason. Never change thresholds, seeds, geometry or number of target modes.
